extracted.name: Kir impériale
extracted.description: If you're a fan of sweet and sharp blackcurrant cassis, try this twist on a classic kir royale cocktail made with sparkling sake
ingredient_lines: 100ml sparkling sake (we used Akashi-Tai Junmai sparkling sake)
instruction_lines: Put a champagne flute into the fridge to chill. Once cold, pour in the crème de cassis.
Pour the sparkling sake into the glass over the back of a spoon to create a layered drink. Garnish with an orange peel twist and serve.
